atom_statement: Use persistent identifiers for dataset authors and input data, so datasets can be reliably filtered and linked by them.
source_passage: a key requirement is the ability to rely on persistent identifiers
need_statement: Users can know the unique identifier of the dataset.

reviewer_1.label: partial
reviewer_1.rationale: Asks for a dataset's own unique identifier, not persistent identifiers for its authors and input data used for filtering and linking.
